subject: Redwood Dedicated - SkyWave reserved pool proposal & discount counteroffer
messages:
From: Bethany Cole <bethany@skywave.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Rogers <evan.rogers@skywave.ai>, SkyWave Procurement <procurement@skywave.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Dedicated proposal - discount request and sizing clarification

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the draft Dedicated proposal and the pool sizing recommendations. We're excited about the performance profiles you shared — the 4xA100 pool looks like a good fit for our burst+steady mix. Before we move to legal, procurement has pushed back on the list pricing.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you match the competitor rate we were quoted (Ref: NebulaAI 12-month reserved at 18% off list)?
- Are you willing to provide a $100k onboarding credit for the migration window (model warm-up, KV cache priming, and pilot infra)?

We can commit to a 12-month reserved commit at the recommended GPU pool size if we can get closer to those economics. I attached our RFP and traffic profile.

Appreciate a quick response — procurement wants an answer this week.

Best,
Bethany
Bethany Cole
Head of Cloud Ops, SkyWave AI
bethany@skywave.ai
+1 415-555-0191

Attachments: SkyWave_RFP_Q1-2027.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@skywave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated proposal - discount request and sizing clarification

Hi Bethany — thanks for the clear asks and for the RFP.

Short answers up front:
- Competitor matching: we can consider a competitive match but need an internal approval for anything beyond our standard reserved discount band.
- Onboarding credit: we typically offer migration credits for strategic pilots; need to confirm the amount with my manager.

I'll loop in Marcus (SRE/solutions) to validate the pool sizing against your traffic profile, and circle up with our sales leadership for a final economics answer. Can you confirm the committed QPS targets you expect during peak and steady-state? That will help shape the throughput guarantee clause.

I'll aim to get you a formal counter by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: (650) 555-2233

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Bethany Cole <bethany@skywave.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated proposal - traffic profile / pool sizing verification

Bethany / Sean — I pulled the attached sizing notes after running your profile through our capacity planner. Key notes:
- Recommended starting pool: 4xA100 (reserved) with autoscale headroom up to 6 nodes for peak spikes.
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~480 TPS token-level across models (mixed seq lengths).
- 99th pctl token latency SLO: ~120ms with continuous batching and KV cache priming.

If SkyWave can commit to the 12-month reserved profile with a 3-month ramp (pilot -> warmed cache -> steady), we can lock in the throughput guarantee in the SOW. I attached a short TDS.

Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sla-summary.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Dedicated proposal - discount request and sizing clarification

Laura / Vivek — moving to you for approval. SkyWave (strategic AI platform) is asking us to match NebulaAI's 18% reserved discount and a $100k onboarding credit in exchange for a 12-month reserved commit on a 4xA100 pool with a standard ramp.

Context: high visibility account, potential expansion across multiple product lines if initial deployment meets SLA. Competitive urgency — they already have a favorable quote from Nebula.

Proposal options I recommend:
A) Approve 18% list discount + $50k onboarding credit (our ask: 12-month commit, 10% overage buffer on committed tokens for first 90 days).
B) Approve 15% discount + $100k onboarding credit + 30% of first-year usage to be reimbursed as performance credits if we miss 99th pctl latency SLO twice.

Both options preserve margin differently. Marcus thinks the A100 pool sizing is correct and that SLA risk is manageable with our prefetched cache approach. Need final sign-off to respond to procurement by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Sean

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Dedicated proposal - discount request and sizing clarification

Sean — after reviewing margin impact and strategic value, I approve a blended concession we can stand behind. Final approved counter:
- 17% reserved discount (applies to committed pool for 12 months)
- $75,000 onboarding credit applied to first invoice (one-time)
- Performance credit clause: if we miss the 99th pctl latency SLO more than twice in a billing quarter, SkyWave receives a credit equal to 10% of that quarter's Dedicated invoice (capped at 25% of onboarding credit).
- We will include a 30-day pilot period during which we will not charge overage fees and will provide engineering support for cache warm-up.

Please push this counter to Bethany and ask procurement for the Nebula quote details (line items) so we can confirm parity if needed.

Laura Bennett
VP, Global Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Cole <bethany@skywave.ai>, SkyWave Procurement <procurement@skywave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Dedicated proposal - discount request and sizing clarification

Hi Bethany / Evan — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Appreciated the RFP context.

Final counter from Redwood (for SkyWave AI, deal RD-2027-1145):
- 12-month reserved commit for a 4xA100 pool (autoscale to 6 nodes for bursts).
- 17% discount on committed reserved pricing for the 12-month term.
- One-time $75,000 onboarding credit applied to the first invoice to help with migration/warm-up costs.
- 30-day pilot with no overage charges and dedicated SE time for cache priming.
- SLA & performance credits: if the 99th pctl token-level latency SLO is missed more than twice in a quarter, we will apply a credit equal to 10% of that quarter's Dedicated invoice (credit capped at 25% of onboarding credit).

Attachments: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (breakdown of committed pricing, overage bands, and projected unit economics).

We believe this balances competitive parity while protecting Redwood's unit economics. If you can share the NebulaAI quote line items, we'll confirm parity on specific SKU comparisons. Happy to hop on a call Monday to finalize.

Next steps:
- Bethany: confirm whether SkyWave accepts the 17% / $75k package or wants us to consider matching Nebula line-by-line.
- Sean: schedule a 30-min call Mon to walk legal/procurement through the SOW and SLA language.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to contract.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
(650) 555-2233

Attachments: pricing_model_v3.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)
